title: Current Applications: Phase 56I First-Pass Decision
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: The NIST MEP record pairs an approximately 60-person current workforce description with attributed results of production rising from 40 to 105 units per day, lead time falling 50 percent, and WIP falling from 105 to 5 units. Phase 56I decision: The first-pass record materially deepens labor-and-output context but remains Partially Closed because the workforce description and intervention results are not a compatible repeated same-line series under one declared period.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Current facility workforce denominator paired with repeat same-line output.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when a dated company, MEP, grant, or customer record reports repeat same-line input and output under a declared window.
why_it_matters: The first-pass decision records whether a named official rail supplies the required denominator without converting adjacent or partial evidence into false closure.
ftfn_relevance: Completes the Phase 56I first-pass queue under a dated source check.
Keeps evidence state separate from performance, safety, quality, readiness, and value.
evidence_limits: The case study is company- and program-attributed and does not publish repeat dates, labor hours, yield, scrap, downtime, cost, demand, or an independently audited counterfactual.
Repeat same-line output, labor hours, yield, scrap, downtime, cost, delivery, demand, and dated capital execution under a compatible window.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
